exercises.title: A Room Change
exercises.script: The evening class will meet in Room 204 tonight because the heating system is being repaired in the usual classroom. The start time remains seven o’clock, and students should bring their course books as usual.
exercises.question: Why has the class been moved?
options: The heating system is being repaired.
exercises.explanation: The announcement says the heating system is being repaired in the usual room.

exercises.title: A Library Book Renewal
exercises.script: You can renew most library books online twice, provided nobody else has requested them. If another reader places a request, the book must be returned by its original due date.
exercises.question: When can a book not be renewed?
options: When it is borrowed for the first time
When another reader has requested it
When the renewal is done online
When it has been renewed twice
exercises.explanation: A request from another reader prevents renewal.

exercises.title: A Course Deadline
exercises.script: The first assignment is due next Wednesday, not this Wednesday as some students seem to believe. You may submit it any time before midnight, but late work will receive reduced feedback.
exercises.question: When is the assignment due?
options: At the end of the month
exercises.explanation: The assignment is due next Wednesday and may be submitted before midnight.

exercises.title: An Academic Qualification
exercises.script: The findings are consistent with the hypothesis, but consistency alone does not establish causation. Further experiments would be needed to determine whether the observed relationship is genuinely responsible for the outcome.
exercises.question: What does the speaker say is still needed?
options: A new hypothesis with no evidence
exercises.explanation: The speaker says further experiments are needed to establish causation.

exercises.title: Integrated Listening Review
exercises.script: The university is introducing a shared bicycle program for students and staff. The first phase will include 120 bicycles at four locations near the main campus. Users will need to register online, and the first thirty minutes of each trip will be free. The university plans to evaluate the program after six months before deciding whether to expand it to the residential campus.
exercises.question: What will the university do after six months?
options: Evaluate the program before deciding about expansion
Move all bicycles to the residential campus
exercises.explanation: The university will evaluate the first phase before deciding whether to expand the program.
